summaries.name: Japan
summaries.summary: The user moved to Japan and initially found it hard to understand the cultural context; this improved over time by making local friends and joining language exchange groups. The user has Japanese co-workers and practices the language with them.

summaries.name: Duolingo
summaries.summary: Duolingo is one of the most popular language learning apps, using gamified exercises to teach new words, phrases, and grammar.

summaries.name: Rosetta Stone
summaries.summary: Rosetta Stone offers immersive language lessons with speech recognition software to practice speaking.

summaries.name: Babbel
summaries.summary: Babbel provides personalized language lessons in bite-sized chunks and offers real-world conversations.

summaries.name: Memrise
summaries.summary: Memrise uses mnemonics to help learners memorize words, phrases, and grammatical concepts.

summaries.name: Lingodeer
summaries.summary: Lingodeer is a language learning app that provides courses with interactive games, videos, and quizzes to help learners progress in their language skills.
